name: 195-version-probe-unparseable-line
note: #195: the plugin version probe agent copied no PROBE line (an unresolved agent type, a probe-run.cjs that cannot run). The probe failed, the manifest was never read: the run ends as the documented provision-failed with probeReason unparseable-line, not as an unreadable plugin version.

args.brief: a probe that printed no line must not be reported as an unreadable plugin version
